ORG.note: The manipulator (e.g. the platform owner) choosing edges to add/remove is the controlling agent in the election-control problems; could also be read as BRI (external non-voter manipulator), ORG chosen as listed first. Knowledge of all voters' scores is only inferable from the problem input; in the reoptimization variant it also knows an optimal solution to a nearby instance.

BRI.note: The external manipulator is coded under ORG (controlling agent in control problems) to avoid double coding.
